text:
elaine_cs: Heads-up: Meridian Systems renewal (50 seats) needs to close by Friday. Procurement asking for PO + vendor code; finance open to credit card if buyer covers ~2% fee. Also they requested a short security addendum. Who will own signatures and payment path? cc @mike_acct @jordan_legal

mike_acct: I can handle PO/vendor code. Will ping procurement (Melissa) now and get required PO fields.

jordan_legal: Pricing fine. Term change request: 12->9 months pro rata. OK as long as auto-renew remains. For the security addendum, ask buyer if SOC2 attestation suffices or if they'll upload their draft.

sophia_fin: If CC used, we still need a PO marked "CC final" for records. If PO/net30 and billed to EU entity, need invoice split approval. CC is fastest for activation.

tom_success: Buyer portal needs 3 approvals: procurement/legal/finance. They prefer PO to avoid fees but will do CC. Scheduling a quick signoff call tomorrow 10am PT to finalize.

esign-bot: Draft envelope created: MeridianRenewal_2918765432. Waiting for SOW attachment. Link: https://docusign.example/meridian/abc123

mike_acct: Procurement confirmed vendor codes: VC-1010 (US), VC-EU-2020 (EU). Will include GL code in PO email.

elaine_cs: Plan: 1) 10am PT signoff. 2) If CC -> route DocuSign to finance lead and enable same-day activation. 3) If PO -> expect 48-72h procurement processing. Aim for signatures by Fri EOD. Post any blockers here.
